lessons.correction: Strengthen ground army, increase economy, maintain expansions and production, continue tech.
lessons.mistake: Being too passive and letting the Terran dictate the pace, neglecting army production while expanding.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.
lessons.title: Balanced Macro with Ground Focus
lessons.when: Early game, opponent ground posture (Marine/Reaper), own Zergling/Queen, moderate production and light tech.
lessons.why: Maintaining a balanced macro approach supports a strong midgame.

lessons.mistake: Being passive and letting the Terran dictate the pace, neglecting upgrades.

lessons.title: Late Midgame Preparation
lessons.when: Late midgame, opponent ground posture (SiegeTank/Marine/Reaper/Hellion), own Zergling/Queen, heavy production and tech.
lessons.why: In late midgame, you need to prepare for large engagements; maintaining economy while teching is crucial.

lessons.title: Transition to Midgame
lessons.when: Early midgame, opponent ground posture (Marine/Reaper/Hellion), own Zergling/Queen, moderate tech.
lessons.why: As you transition to midgame, you need to start teching to counter opponent's composition; maintaining economy is key.
